description: Finds hotels ahead of a driver or traveller who is on the road and wants a room for tonight: give where they are now, where they are heading and how many hours of driving they have left. Results come in groups along the way: about 30, 60 and 120 minutes ahead, the last stop before their driving hours run out, and around the destination. Each group has up to three hotels with a short `spoken` line written to be read aloud, the minutes ahead, whether the hotel lists truck parking, and the nightly and total price. `recommended_group` names the group to offer first. How to use the answer: read the spoken line for the first two or three hotels in the recommended group; before the person picks one, say its price and how many minutes ahead it is. When `estimate` is true the drive times are estimates (a straight line to the destination at a typical truck speed, not road routing), so say they are approximate. A group listed in `unavailable` could not be checked; that is not the same as no hotels there. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone. To book one of these hotels, call search_hotels with that hotel's latitude and longitude and the same dates, then create_booking_intent with the chosen offer, as for any hotel.

check_in.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD): usually today in the driver's own time zone.

destination.description: Where the driver is heading. The stops along the way are worked out from the line between here and there.

name.description: Place name, e.g. 'Houston, TX' (optional, used in the answer).

hours_left.description: Driving hours the driver has left today (0-14). Hotels past that point are left out, and a stop just before the hours run out is added.

rooms.description: Rooms (default 1, at most the number of adults).

truck_parking.description: Look first for hotels that list truck parking (default true). Set false for a car.

name: find_hotels_on_route
